subject: CAMEL Ultra Light 83 CPB Final Specifications
brief_summary: CAMEL Ultra Light 83 started production on October 1, 1990. A Phase III was run the week of 10/16/90. An evaluation of the Phase III data and weekly "tar"/CATE data indicates that Holes Open/Holes Closed Draft and FTC "Tar" specifications should be modified. Recommended final specifications are attached.
